decisions.value: Native unitControl validates possession. Flyers retain Acro/Stabilized/Build; grounded units use native movement capabilities and Q/E stance; ControlBlock turret proxies are stationary. Host-only Allow ground-unit flight defaults OFF; F8 requests a per-instance XYZ override and safe landing on release/revocation. Native unarmed units stay unarmed and noncontrollable categories remain explicit exceptions.
Original profiles and runtime settings are versioned in flight/performance/navigation sheets; no Liftoff code.
Installed Steam content is read-only; play and isolated lab profiles under D:/Linux/MindustryFPV.
